original: T: For this game, I made the most of the Super Famicom’s 8-voice sound system
current: <Dr. Pez> T：为这款游戏，我充分利用了超级任天堂的8通道发声系统
suggested: T：为这款游戏，我充分利用了超级红白机的8声部发声系统，创作出以原声乐器演奏、旋律富有情感的音乐。（说话人应为多和田吏，而非Dr. Pez）
why: O begins with the label "T:" (Tawada, per the "J:" label convention) and the line is the composer's reply about his own work, yet the row is attributed to Dr. Pez; also Super Famicom is rendered 超级任天堂 here but 超级红白机 in row 79.

original: the Super Famicom’s limited sound system
current: 超级任天堂发声系统有限
suggested: 超级红白机发声系统有限
why: Super Famicom is rendered 超级红白机 in row 79 but 超级任天堂 here and in row 105; inconsistent within the post.

original: ファミコン時代のゲームの難易度
current: 任天堂时代的游戏难度
suggested: 红白机时代的游戏难度
why: ファミコン (Famicom) is rendered as 任天堂, which loses the console reference and changes the meaning.

original: Junichi Masuda (que también es el responsable de la música desde los inicios...)
current: 增田顺一（Junichi Masuda）是Game Freak的创始人之一，长期担任制作人和作曲家
suggested: 增田顺一（Junichi Masuda）是Game Freak的资深制作人，从系列初期起负责音乐。
why: O calls him only a veteran producer and the series' composer since the beginning; the note's claim that he co-founded Game Freak is not in O (and is not accurate).
